semantic_review_method: Read all retained goal contracts, including locally retained V15, then compare the required transformation and error/state behavior. Similar mathematical/string subroutines do not make a reused goal; names and hashes alone are not semantic freshness.

held_out_review.distinct_goal: Returns a reduced signed rational pair with positive denominator and canonical zero, rather than returning a divisor or quotient.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: V15 population count; current14B count-multiples and integer-power
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Counts carry-producing digit positions in addition across bases and cascades, rather than counting set bits, interval multiples or exponentiating.
Reverses a fixed-width bit sequence including leading zeros; counting set bits does not satisfy this output contract.
Decodes exactly three original backslash escape forms once and rejects malformed sequences; previous cases encoded text.
Removes per-line hash comments while retaining all original newline boundaries; no prior task performed comment removal.
Transforms the case of each ASCII word while preserving separators; previous cases counted words or substituted letters.
Returns a stable permutation of original indices by numeric order, rather than sorted input values or filtered elements.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: Stable unique, without None, group runs
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Subtracts one remaining equality match per requested occurrence while preserving object identity; duplicates are not globally removed.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: Matrix transpose, main diagonal, matrix product; current14B select-positions
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Selects arbitrary repeated columns in caller order with strict index validation; it neither transposes, multiplies nor extracts a fixed diagonal. Vector position selection is a shared building block, but this task validates a rectangular matrix and returns newly selected rows; vector selection does not meet that matrix contract.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: Traffic phase transition, boolean toggle; current14B job-transition/run-state
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Validates caller-directed actions against a noncyclic transition graph; invalid actions leave state untouched. It owns mutable state and rejects invalid transitions atomically, unlike the stateless pair-to-result job mapping or idempotent two-event run mapping.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: Merge counts, bounded debit, rename key
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Atomically replaces existing count values using a fully validated update batch; previous cases added counts, withdrew a balance or renamed one key.

held_out_review.nearest_retained_contracts: V15 HH:MM, ASCII integer/port/percentage, hex byte
held_out_review.distinct_goal: Parses an integer-plus-exact-binary-unit grammar and scales to bytes; no prior task accepted unit suffixes or binary scaling.
